_authority: PRICING-SSOT.md is canonical; this file is a machine-readable mirror for document-ops-portal billing wiring (do NOT hand-edit; regenerate from SSOT on tier price change).
_model: Pass-through: rate ~= marginal LLM+OCR+storage cost. Margin lives in subscription (sub - included-volume cost), not in overage. Aligned with callmeie-financials/build_model.py L292 'negligible marginal cost' assumption and MEMORY.md 'overage ~= cost' doctrine. Raw per-doc cost ~= 0.01 EUR (Grok-4 in+out + Hetzner Object Storage). 0.05 EUR rate = 5x cost buffer for retry + ops headroom.
_rescue_split_rationale: Rescue+Export has two distinct overage axes: machine docs above 250/mo cap (priced same as Auto/Auto Plus at 0.05 EUR/doc) AND human-reviewer rescues above 10/mo cap (priced at 15 EUR/rescue, sized to Adam reviewer-minute at 60-120 EUR/hr * ~10 min). Backend billing meter MUST track these as two separate metered events to avoid the WBC 'human rescue unit-undefined' dispute risk surfaced in 2026-05-20 audit.

rescue_export._note: TWO metered axes. Backend Stripe Billing Meter MUST track docs_extracted AND human_rescues_consumed as separate event streams. Combined billing breaks unit attribution; resolves WBC 'human rescue unit-undefined' (2026-05-20 audit).

bespoke._note: Per-engagement quote. No published overage rate.
